chapter_title_en: The Martial Ancestor's Might Shakes the Heavens

chapter_meta_description: The Martial Ancestor at the Ninth Heaven crushes Ancestral God remnants, captures Half-Ancestors, bestows gifts upon his followers, and strides toward the Eternal Light in a poignant farewell.
og_title: The Martial Ancestor's Final March to the Eternal Light
og_description: The Martial Ancestor appears at the peak of his power, interrogates the captured about the Oracle Bone Diagram, and sets off on a one-way journey into the deepest Death World.
twitter_description: The Nine Heavens Martial Ancestor defeats all, bestows gifts, and departs toward the Eternal Light in a tragic, calculated sacrifice.
